headline: Rays Win the ALCS
caption:
The Tampa Bay Rays have won the ALCS, taking the series 4-2 over the Cleveland Guardians.

Our model called it before the series started: Tampa Bay at a 56% chance, with a projected 4-3 series. The pick was right, and the length came within one game. A 56% call is closer to a coin flip than a lock, so this one was earned on the field.

That makes our pre-series picks 7 of 9 so far this postseason.

Did you see the Rays winning this series, or did Cleveland have you convinced?
